results.name: lease claim
results.source: acquireLease (packages/engine/src/lease.ts), statement read from the source
results.statement: update conversations c set lease_token = $1::uuid, lease_until = now() + make_interval(secs => $2) where c.id = $3 and c.mode = 'ai' and c.ai_enabled and (c.lease_until is null or c.lease_until < now()) and coalesce((select s.ai_enabled from creator_settings s where s.creator_id = c.creator_id), true) returning c.version, c.creator_id as "creatorId", c.fan_id as "fanId"
scans: Index Scan on conversations using conversations_pkey

results.name: inbound load
results.source: loadInbound (packages/engine/src/turn.ts), statement read from the source
results.statement: select m.id, m.body from messages m where m.conversation_id = $1 and m.sender = 'fan' and m.turn_id is null and m.created_at > coalesce((select max(o.created_at) from messages o where o.conversation_id = $2 and o.sender in ('creator', 'admin') and o.status = 'sent'), 'epoch'::timestamptz) order by m.created_at, m.id
scans: Index Only Scan on messages using messages_staff_sent_idx
Index Scan on messages using messages_unanswered_idx

results.name: facts
results.statement: select coalesce((select no_pitch_until > now() from conversations where id = $1), false) as no_pitch_active, (select count(*)::int from offers where conversation_id = $2 and status = 'declined' and resolved_at > now() - make_interval(mins => $3::int)) as declines, (select count(*)::int from turns t where t.conversation_id = $4 and t.outcome = 'replied' and t.offer_id is null and cardinality(t.inbound_ids) > 0 and t.created_at > coalesce((select max(created_at) from offers where conversation_id = $5), 'epoch'::timestamptz)) as since_offer, coalesce((select hold_suppressed_until > now() from conversations where id = $6), false) as hold_suppressed, exists(select 1 from handoffs where conversation_id = $7 and status <> 'resolved') as unresolved, exists(select 1 from offers where conversation_id = $8 and status = 'open' and expires_at > now()) as open_offer, exists(select 1 from offers where conversation_id = $9 and status = 'accepted') as unlocked, exists( select 1 from offers o where o.conversation_id = $10 and o.status = 'accepted' and o.resolved_at > coalesce( (select max(m.created_at) from messages m where m.conversation_id = $11 and m.sender in ('ai', 'creator', 'admin') and m.status = 'sent'), '-infinity'::timestamptz) ) as just_unlocked
scans: Index Scan on conversations using conversations_pkey
Index Scan on messages using messages_conversation_created_idx

results.name: published card read
results.source: the select in runTurn (packages/engine/src/turn.ts), built with the same drizzle calls
results.statement: select "id", "creator_id", "version", "body", "never_list", "published_at" from "persona_cards" where ("persona_cards"."creator_id" = $1 and "persona_cards"."published_at" is not null) order by "persona_cards"."version" desc limit $2
scans: Index Scan on persona_cards using persona_cards_creator_version_unique

results.name: chat history
results.source: loadHistory (packages/engine/src/turn.ts), built with the same drizzle calls
results.statement: select "id" from "messages" where ("messages"."conversation_id" = $1 and "messages"."status" = $2 and "messages"."sender" <> $3) order by "messages"."created_at" desc, "messages"."id" desc limit $4

results.name: retrieval, full text
results.statement: select meta->>'chunk_id' as chunk_id, text, ts_rank_cd(tsv, to_tsquery('simple', $1)) as score from persona_chunks where creator_id = $2 and tsv @@ to_tsquery('simple', $3) order by score desc, id limit $4

results.name: retrieval, vector
results.statement: select meta->>'chunk_id' as chunk_id, text, 1 - (embedding <=> $1::vector) as score from persona_chunks where creator_id = $2 and embedding is not null order by embedding <=> $3::vector, id limit $4

results.name: sweep scan
results.source: sweep (packages/engine/src/sweep.ts), run with a clock past its start budget so it scans and processes nothing
results.statement: select c.id, min(m.created_at) as oldest from conversations c join messages m on m.conversation_id = c.id where c.mode = 'ai' and c.ai_enabled and c.lease_until is null and m.sender = 'fan' and m.turn_id is null and m.created_at < now() - make_interval(secs => $1) and m.created_at > coalesce((select max(o.created_at) from messages o where o.conversation_id = c.id and o.sender in ('creator', 'admin') and o.status = 'sent'), 'epoch'::timestamptz) group by c.id order by min(m.created_at), c.id limit $2
scans: Index Only Scan on messages using messages_staff_sent_idx
Index Only Scan on messages using messages_unanswered_idx

results.name: creator inbox page
results.statement: select "conversations"."id", "conversations"."mode", "conversations"."ai_enabled", "users"."name", "users"."email", "conversations"."created_at", (select m.body from messages m where m.conversation_id = "conversations"."id" and m.status = 'sent' and not m.suggested and (m.deliver_at is null or m.deliver_at <= now()) order by coalesce(m.deliver_at, m.created_at) desc, m.id desc limit 1), (select m.sender::text from messages m where m.conversation_id = "conversations"."id" and m.status = 'sent' and not m.suggested and (m.deliver_at is null or m.deliver_at <= now()) order by coalesce(m.deliver_at, m.created_at) desc, m.id desc limit 1), (select extract(epoch from now() - coalesce(m.deliver_at, m.created_at)) * 1000 from messages m where m.conversation_id = "conversations"."id" and m.status = 'sent' and not m.suggested and (m.deliver_at is null or m.deliver_at <= now()) order by coalesce(m.deliver_at, m.created_at) desc, m.id desc limit 1)::float8, exists (select 1 from handoffs h where h.conversation_id = "conversations"."id" and h.queue = 'creator' and h.status <> 'resolved'), exists (select 1 from messages m where m.conversation_id = "conversations"."id" and m.suggested and m.status = 'blocked'), "conversations"."creator_id", (select h.queue::text from handoffs h where h.conversation_id = "conversations"."id" and h.status = 'open'), (select h.reason::text from handoffs h where h.conversation_id = "conversations"."id" and h.status = 'open'), (select extract(epoch from h.due_at - now()) * 1000 from handoffs h where h.conversation_id = "conversations"."id" and h.status = 'open')::float8, (select extract(epoch from now() - h.opened_at) * 1000 from handoffs h where h.conversation_id = "conversations"."id" and h.status = 'open')::float8, exists (select 1 from handoffs h where h.conversation_id = "conversations"."id" and h.status = 'open' and h.sla_breached_at is not null), extract(epoch from now() - "conversations"."created_at") * 1000 from "conversations" inner join "users" on "users"."id" = "conversations"."fan_id" where ("conversations"."creator_id" in (select "id" from "creators" where "creators"."user_id" = $1) and "conversations"."mode" not in ('handoff_ts','human_ts') and not exists (select 1 from "handoffs" where ("handoffs"."conversation_id" = "conversations"."id" and "handoffs"."queue" = $2 and "handoffs"."status" <> $3))) order by '0'::text, coalesce((select max(coalesce(m.deliver_at, m.created_at)) from messages m where m.conversation_id = "conversations"."id"), "conversations"."created_at") desc, "conversations"."id" desc
scans: Index Scan on users using users_pkey

results.name: handoff queue (open handoffs for one creator)
results.statement: select count(*) as n from handoffs h join conversations c on c.id = h.conversation_id where ((c.creator_id in ($1::uuid) and not exists (select 1 from users ef where ef.id = c.fan_id and ef.email like $2) and true) and c.mode not in ('handoff_ts', 'human_ts') and not exists (select 1 from handoffs th where th.conversation_id = c.id and th.queue = 'ts')) and h.status = 'open'
scans: Index Scan on users using users_email_unique
